name: How do I choose the right size and style for my outdoor fireplace?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size and style for my outdoor fireplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size and style involves considering your outdoor living space dimensions, existing landscaping, and overall home architectural style. A fireplace should be proportionate to the area, neither overwhelming nor undersized. Consider how you plan to use the space: for large gatherings or intimate settings. Style choices range from rustic and traditional to modern and minimalist. We can help assess your space and preferences during a consultation to recommend suitable options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your outdoor space size, existing landscape, and home's style to choose a proportionate fireplace that fits your aesthetic and functional needs.
